newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian bourse activity keeps climbing.
newsitem.headline: Latvian bourse activity keeps climbing.

text.p: Trade in Latvian shares rose further on Thursday, with leading bank Unibanka, Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) and fish cannery Kaija in the spotlight.
Overall market turnover was 76,074 lats and Unibanka accounted for most of the business as usual.
It registered trade of 55,160 lats and its share price rose slightly to 1.96 lats from 1.94 lats.
RTF, the second share on the official list, saw volume of 6,019 lats and was stable at 85 santimes.
Kaija was again the most active on the secondary list on 8,906 lats trade and a share rise of 14 percent to 57 santimes.
The Mangali Shipyard was the next most traded at 3,044 lats and a share price rise of one santime to 27.
The Daugavpils Motor Chain factory was also well traded, turning over 1,351 lats of shares and dipping to 39 santimes from 40, the bourse said.
